test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the pair which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two set of pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

KJL−NMO

LKM−ONP6445
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0a84f54891373ca758d3985fc7ad60a3c9c5a6040045b7dde79068c45ff1c74.png] 

**Given: **

KJL−NMO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69e510e101b02258810849c55780d42761de8f77ac510d8b2fc693bcf06941cb.png] 

LKM−ONP6445

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e5ae598275b04f4e5d54ed5085f3f40f5856d7df65bcc433ba93f9e97fe9ec5.png] 

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +3, +3, +3.

Let's check each option:

1. VUW – YXZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0899511bfd6e3f716430230fb212d40479696f8564b9fcfff58058f21655fefe.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +3, +3, +3.

2. VTU – XWY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c53dc0fd5ad03ca21c58429fe8070a30e5bcea9cc8fd50944f09b034d3600eda.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +3, +3, +3.

3. VUW – XXY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/523c5a15f99535a829617ae78c85901459c0abdb2b444d6fd0d6dc832d755d86.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +3, +3, +3.
4. VTU – YXZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea0e94cb1a63a9ac3da4ed78afe2334aa892ef991fa81d85bf934d4705b9fcc9.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +3, +3, +3.

 

Thus, VUW−YXZ follows the same pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
